area.title: Mikros Gialos
area.intro: A quiet bay with clear water on the south-east coast of Lefkada, below the village of Poros. This is where we are, 50 metres from the beach.
area.bayAlt: Mikros Gialos bay from above, with sailing boats and the beach
area.walk.title: In the bay, on foot
area.walk.beach.title: The beach
area.walk.beach.desc: Pebbles and clear, calm water. The bay is sheltered from the wind, so the sea usually stays calm even when the west coast has waves. You'll find sunbeds and umbrellas on the beach.
area.walk.food.title: Tavernas and mini markets
area.walk.food.desc: Tavernas serving fresh fish and beach bars along the beach and by the little harbour, plus mini markets for the basics.
area.walk.sea.title: Water sports
area.walk.sea.desc: Kayaks, paddleboards and pedal boats are for rent on the beach, so you can see the bay from the water.
area.duskAlt: Mikros Gialos bay at dusk, with sailing boats at anchor
area.drive.title: By car
area.drive.sivota: A small harbour full of boats, with fish tavernas around the bay.
area.drive.nidri: The biggest resort on the east coast. Boat trips to Meganisi and Skorpios leave from here, and the Dimosari waterfalls are close by.
area.drive.vasiliki: One of the best windsurfing spots in Europe, with a steady wind in the afternoons.
area.drive.agiofili: A small beach with crystal-clear water, near Vasiliki.
area.drive.lefkadaTown: The island's capital, with its marina and pedestrian streets full of shops.
area.drive.portoKatsiki: One of the best-known beaches in Greece, below tall white cliffs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1.title: 1. Introduction
privacy.section1.content: Welcome to Metaxas Retreats ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share your information when you visit our website or make a booking at our property in Mikros Gialos, Lefkada.
privacy.section2.title: 2. Information We Collect
privacy.section2.intro: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you make a reservation or contact us, including:
privacy.section2.item1: Names and Contact Details (Email, Phone Number)
privacy.section2.item2: Booking Details (Arrival/Departure dates, Number of guests)
privacy.section2.item3: Payment Information (Processed securely by our payment providers; we do not store credit card details on our servers)
privacy.section2.item4: Contact form inquiries and booking requests submitted through our website

privacy.section4.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking
privacy.section4.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies (like Google Analytics) to access or store information. This helps us analyze website traffic and improve your user experience. You can refuse the use of cookies by adjusting your browser settings.
privacy.section5.title: 5. Data Retention
privacy.section5.content: We keep your information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this privacy policy, unless a longer retention period is required by law (such as tax, accounting, or other legal requirements).

privacy.section6.content: We use Formspree (formspree.io) to deliver contact form submissions and booking requests to us by email. We also use Google Analytics 4 to analyze website traffic — this is only activated after you have given explicit consent via the cookie banner. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect anonymized usage data. For more information, see Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

privacy.section7.content: If you have questions or comments about this policy, you may email us at metaxasretreats@gmail.com.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How far is Metaxas Retreats from the beach?
faq.a1: Our accommodations are just 50 meters from Mikros Gialos beach, one of the most beautiful bays in Lefkada with crystal-clear turquoise waters.
faq.q2: What is the best time to visit Lefkada?
faq.a2: May to October offers the best weather for visiting Lefkada. July and August are peak season with warmest temperatures, while May–June and September–October offer pleasant weather with fewer crowds.
faq.q3: What accommodations are available at Metaxas Retreats?
faq.a3: We offer two types of accommodation: a charming Wooden House with sea views sleeping up to 4 guests, and a spacious Glamping Tent among olive trees sleeping up to 5 guests. Both feature modern amenities and stunning views of Mikros Gialos bay.
faq.q4: Is Metaxas Retreats a campground or glamping site?
faq.a4: Metaxas Retreats offers luxury glamping — combining the best of camping with hotel-quality amenities. Our glamping tent provides a unique outdoor experience with comfortable beds, air conditioning, private bathroom, and fully equipped kitchen.
faq.q5: How do I get to Metaxas Retreats from Lefkada Town?
faq.a5: From Lefkada Town, drive south along the east coast through Nidri, then follow the signs for Poros and Mikros Gialos. It's about 30 km and takes around 45 minutes. From Aktion airport (Preveza), allow about 1 hour 10 minutes.
faq.q6: What beaches are near Metaxas Retreats?
faq.a6: Mikros Gialos beach is just 50m away. Other nearby beaches include Agiofili, Porto Katsiki, and the beaches around Sivota bay.
faq.q7: How do I book at Metaxas Retreats?
faq.a7: Book directly with us for a discount: choose your dates on the accommodation page and send a request, message us on WhatsApp at +30 697 321 9980, or email metaxasretreats@gmail.com. You can also find us on Airbnb and Booking.com.
